      Travel to India

      Experience the Vibrant Culture and Heritage of India with Saudia Airlines

      Embrace a land of infinite color and timeless wonder where every corner tells a story of ancient glory and modern vitality. From the golden sands of the coast to the majestic peaks of the north, India invites you on a sensory journey through its legendary hospitality and spiritual depth. Fly with Saudia to discover the heart of this subcontinent through its rich traditions and world-renowned culinary artistry.


      1. Savor Authentic Street Food Delights

      Dive into the lively atmosphere of local markets to taste legendary chaat and crispy samosas. These bold flavors offer an immediate and delicious connection to the local way of life.


      2. Master Traditional Indian Cooking Techniques

      Join expert chefs to learn the art of tempering spices and slow-cooking perfection. Discover how traditional methods like bhuna and dum bring out the soul of every dish.


      3. Explore Vibrant Local Spice Markets

      Breathe in the aromatic scents of cardamom and saffron in bustling bazaars. These historic centers of trade are a feast for the senses and the source of India's world-famous flavors.


      4. Witness Captivating Regional Folk Dances

      Feel the energy of rhythmic performances that celebrate local history and folklore. Each movement and costume reflects the unique spirit and artistic heritage of its region.


      5. Indulge In Iconic Sweet Treats

      Treat yourself to the golden syrupy goodness of jalebis or the creamy texture of gulab jamun. These beloved desserts are the perfect finale to any authentic Indian meal.


      6. Experience Luxury In Heritage Hotels

      Step back in time by staying in restored palaces and historic mansions. These majestic properties combine royal grandeur with modern comforts for an unforgettable stay.


      7. Join A Guided Culinary Tour

      Follow local experts through hidden alleys to find the city's best-kept gastronomic secrets. This curated journey ensures you taste the most authentic flavors in every neighborhood.


      8. Discover Ancient Artisanal Crafts

      Watch master craftsmen create intricate textiles and handmade pottery using skills passed down through generations. These timeless arts are a testament to India's enduring creativity.


      9. Enjoy A Traditional Tea Experience

      Sip on warming masala chai while soaking in the local scenery. This simple ritual offers a peaceful moment to connect with the warmth of Indian hospitality.


      10. Savor Flavorful Regional Curries

      Explore the diverse palette of Indian cuisine through aromatic gravies and spicy regional specialties. From coconut-infused coastal dishes to rich northern classics, every bite is a celebration.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to India

      1. Mumbai

      Experience the electric energy of India's "City of Dreams." Behold the monumental Gateway of India, cruise along the sparkling Marine Drive at sunset, and explore the intricate carvings of the Elephanta Caves. From the high-fashion boutiques of Colaba to the aromatic street food stalls of Juhu Beach, this bustling metropolis blends colonial history with a vibrant, modern soul.


      2. Delhi

      Uncover layers of history in a capital where ancient monuments stand alongside cutting-edge architecture. Marvel at the red sandstone walls of the Red Fort, find tranquility at the Lotus Temple, and wander the historic alleys of Old Delhi to discover the majestic Jama Masjid. Whether you are exploring the lush Lodi Gardens or shopping at Dilli Haat, Delhi offers a captivating journey through time.


      3. Kochi

      Surrender to the coastal charm of Kerala's "Queen of the Arabian Sea." Admire the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets at sunset, wander through the spice-scented streets of Jew Town, and explore the colonial legacy of Fort Kochi. Experience a mesmerizing Kathakali performance or set sail on the serene backwaters to discover the soul of South India in this enchanting port city.
